scope: Disposable local PGlite; SQL auth shim, no hosted writes or payments
checks: New unpaid order holds stock and one promo use for 30 minutes
Idempotent replay does not deduct twice
Other customer cannot oversell held stock
Other customer cannot consume a reserved promo slot
Expiry restores exact inventory and promo slot once
Expired retry returns old cancelled order, not a hidden new purchase
Late payment cannot consume a released reservation
Trusted payment consumes reservation without double deduction
Refund does not automatically restock uninspected goods or reuse paid promo
Explicit unpaid cancellation restores stock once
Customers cannot call expiry or mutate reservation ledger
Payment after deadline is denied even before expiry worker runs
Failure releases new hold and failed orders cannot resurrect payment
Patch refuses reapplication atomically instead of overwriting accounting
Historical orders and promo counters unchanged; no inferred reservations
Unknown checkout body refused before DDL; no partial ledger
